title: Flood Store
shortDescription: A locked cellar of tins, twine, and dry biscuits.
longDescription: The flood-store is under the slip, dry when the river is merely rude. Tins, twine, and a sack of biscuits sit on a shelf above the old waterline. The camp has not got in here. Up is the slip.

fixtures.name: Biscuit Shelf
fixtures.lookDescription: A shelf of tins above the waterline. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The tins are stamped with a turnip, the kitchens' mark. One gap shows where a tin was owed to the refectory and did not arrive. The rest are still here because Marram locked the hatch.
